class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleSpringBrake
class.description: [RailVehicleSpringBrake] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleSpringBrake].

The bit flag specifying the required coupling method to transmit brake control signals in multiple unit operation, e.g. 132 for the necessity of connection with a Jacobs bogie – this allows command transmission e.g. within a permanently coupled unit, but not to subsequent multiple units.
